text: Returning to Earth, the [seven-member working crew|who_suffers|people at work] of the commercial space tug Nostromo is woken by a transmission from a nearby moon and lands to find a derelict alien vessel full of eggs. [A creature clamps itself to Kane's face|rules|it gets inside you], and later, at a final crew meal, [something bursts from his chest|images|monsters and hybrid creatures] and vanishes into the air ducts. As Ripley hunts it through the ship, she uncovers [a secret company directive|threat|the powerful and their systems] that values the alien above the crew.
